The two 320-px cuts are words wider than the whole 170-px line («общеобразовательная» 198 px, «продовольственный» 179 px) — origin/master's markup cuts them too. Across both probes (930 + 832 card×width measurements) there is no word cut on the branch that origin/master's markup keeps whole.

issues.description: On 320–639 px a one-word name that, together with the 32-px pin, does not fit beside the 24-px building icon wraps under the icon and leaves the icon alone on the first line, although the word alone would fit beside it; origin/master kept icon + name together and put the pin alone below instead. 10 of 620 phone measurements (275–288 px «Choyxona»; 320 px «Кондитерская», «Пищекомбинат»; 360 px «Кафе-кондитерская», «Овощехранилище»; 393/412 px «Склад-овощехранилище»; 412 px «Мясоперерабатывающий»). Master's markup leaves the icon alone in 305 of the same measurements, so it is much rarer than before; not among the AC8 check criteria. Not blocking.
issues.repro: Create a point «Кондитерская» (sphere food), open /settings/buildings at 320×658 (Galaxy S9+): line 1 = icon only, line 2 = «Кондитерская 📎» (master: «🏢 Кондитерская» / 📎). Same with «Склад-овощехранилище» at 393 px: branch icon / name / pin on three lines, master icon+name / pin (ac8-hyphen-check-output.txt, screens/hyphen-393-{branch,master-sim}.png; screens/galaxy-s9p-320-Кондитерская-{branch,master-sim}.png). Optional fix: when nameHead is empty, put the icon inside the same inline-block as the word and the pin, so a one-word name breaks like master (icon + word, pin below) instead of orphaning the icon.

issues.description: splitForPin splits at whitespace only, so a hyphenated last word travels with the pin as one unit: «Склад-овощехранилище» at 393 px (213.6 + 32 > 243) puts the pin on its own line although «овощехранилище» + pin would fit after a break at the hyphen (greedy line breaking keeps the whole word on one line). This is the spec's accepted case (last word + pin wider than the line); origin/master's markup also puts the pin alone below the name there (measured: ac8-hyphen-check-output.txt), the branch additionally leaves the icon alone (see AC8-icon-alone-single-word).

The geometric touch zone is exactly 48×48, but Chrome's touch adjustment also routes taps on the plain text of the name up to ~30 px from the pin's centre to the pin (exact CDP taps at 26–30 px toggled, at 37–44 px did not). Platform behaviour that applies to any button (also to master's pin); means a tap on the last letters of the name pins/unpins the object.
